messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — deploy/canary v2.14 triggered PD-65432 for increased 5xx rate in us-west-2 edge. Rolling canary now?

pagerduty: Alert PD-65432 — "embed-service: 5xx spike" — severity: high. https://pagerduty.com/alerts/PD-65432

juniper: acked in PD, taking first touch. Any indication of customer impact?

sam: acked. p95 errors on /v1/embeddings up ~12% for us-west-2 over last 3m. Error 502/504 from edge-proxy to model-runtime. Canary rollout just hit 30% traffic.

maria: saw the same in telemetry. Canary autoscaled a quant-path kernel; suspicious. Suggest stop canary traffic and divert to stable immediately.

dev-lead: rolling back canary tag to v2.13 (sha a1b2c3). Running:
```
# rollback command
rtd-deploy rollback --env=prod --region=us-west-2 --to-tag=v2.13
```

ops: running rollback, pausing rollout, disabling canary traffic via traffic-split API.

ops: command output:
```
Initiating rollback to v2.13...
Stopping canary services...
Traffic split set to stable=100, canary=0
Rollback completed on 12 hosts. Healthchecks passing.
```

sam: saw p95 drop from 3.1s -> 0.34s, 5xx rate back to 0.7% in us-west-2. Good validation.

juniper: temporary mitigation confirmed. Opening PD note: "Roll back canary v2.14 — edge 5xx spike". Est. customer requests affected: ~2% of traffic in us-west-2 for ~8 minutes. No major customer-reported incidents so far.

maria: will keep a watch for 20m. Suggest we do a quick postmortem and add a safety gate to prevent quant-path kernel in canary without perf smoke tests.

dev-lead: agreed. I'll create a rollback-release issue and link to runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-789

juniper: handing off to daytime SRE @maria for follow-up and postmortem. Oncallly wise, marking incident resolved in PD.

pagerduty: PD-65432 marked resolved by juniper.

juniper: closing thread — follow-up: postmortem and rollback checklist will be posted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
